user.title: Loggia Dashboard
user.description: Loggia reads your Home Assistant setup on its own — there is nothing to configure. It will show up as **Loggia** in the sidebar.

scenario.name: Run a scenario
scenario.description: Runs a Loggia scenario: one of its own (nuit, depart, retour, reveil, cinema, musique, invites, tout_eteindre) or one of yours.

id.name: Scenario
id.description: The scenario identifier, as the Scenarios view shows it: nuit, depart… or perso_… for a scenario you added.
